module: "Overhead arrow" checkpoint marker: an arrow (s_mm_arrow_ribbon_down.dae) turned toward the camera, oscillating vertically above the point, colored according to the mode and whose transparency increases up close (fade between fadeNear and fadeFar). The module returns a constructor: require('scenario/raceMarkers/overhead')(id) gives an object of class C.
notes: Colors per mode: default orange (1, 0.333, 0), next black, start and lap green, final blue, branch (1, 0.6, 0.07), hidden black.
setToCheckpoint(wp) reads wp.pos, wp.radius, wp.fadeNear and wp.fadeFar (defaults 5 and 25 m).
In update, the color blend factor t is fixed at 1: the mode change is immediate, with no fade.
The setToCheckpoint comment mentions modes (finish, etc.): the actual names are those of modeInfos (final, lap...).

update.desc: Per-frame call: turns the arrow toward the camera, animates it (0.4 + 0.4*sin) and adjusts color and alpha according to distance.

setToCheckpoint.desc: Places the marker on a checkpoint.

setMode.desc: 'hidden' hides, other mode shows; remembers the old and new mode.

mode.desc: default, next, start, lap, final, branch or hidden.

createObject.desc: Creates a hidden TSStatic registered under objectName and added to ScenarioObjectsGroup.

createMarkers.desc: Removes the old objects then creates the arrow.
